page: Amazon Web Services inf1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8275CL processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 96 virtual CPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and boasting a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the inf1.24xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, particularly in stress-ng multi-core tests, Passmark CPU scores, and cryptographic operations. Memory performance is a key strength, with cached read-only memory bandwidth reaching 5251.25 GB/sec and uncached large-block read bandwidth at 232.48 GB/sec. The server also excels in database operations, achieving 79.6 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and scoring in the top 25% for Passmark database operations. Single-core performance and text processing benchmarks fall within the average range.

While the server family is associated with machine learning inference, the CPU-only configuration of this instance shows mixed results for large language models. Prompt processing speeds are average, but text generation speeds for small and medium models are poor. Consequently, the hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for high-throughput multi-threaded CPU tasks, software compilation, and memory-bandwidth-sensitive workloads rather than generative AI text generation. Appropriate workloads include high-performance database hosting, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, and network-heavy data processing.
description: Amazon Web Services inf1.24xlarge is an x86_64 compute-focused server featuring 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8275CL processor running at 2.5 GHz. It is configured with 192.0 GB of DDR4 RAM, a 100 Gbps baseline network speed, and no local storage or GPUs. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the server delivers strong multi-core CPU performance and exceptional memory bandwidth, scoring in the top 25% for Redis SET operations and Passmark database tests. This server is highly suited for multi-threaded CPU workloads, high-throughput database operations, software compilation, and network-intensive applications.
